title: v2.1.0: Live /now
description: /now renders per request, one line per route, newest first. Kindle covers are back on /reading, /threads has a real light mode, and a lint cleanup fixed typos Prettier had put into live pages.

title: Dispatch
description: Standalone pieces of journalism, each at /dispatch/<slug>.

title: Email Signup
description: An email signup form at the end of every post, self-hosted on listmonk.

title: OLED Black Dark Mode
description: Dark mode is pure black everywhere. Layers are separated by borders, not fills.

title: Automated Deploys
description: A push to main builds, deploys and health-checks the site, and rolls back on its own if the check fails.

title: Projects Archive
description: The projects page shows the whole archive, with two-column flagships and a Games category.

title: Motorcycle Rides
description: Ride maps built from GPX tracks, with photos, audio and notes.

title: Sealed Posts
description: Link-protected posts on a public repo. They are decrypted in the reader's browser.

title: Scheduled Posts
description: Posts can be set to go public at a later time, with no rebuild.

title: Webmentions
description: Webmentions now show on every post.

title: JSON Twins
description: Every page has a JSON version at the same path with a .json suffix.

title: Hand-Drawn Kit
description: Arrows, circled numbers and marks scanned from a notebook, usable as components.

title: AT Protocol Mirror
description: Blog posts are mirrored to AT Protocol (standard.site).

title: Vault Alarm Headings
description: A new display font for headings.

title: Stats Lite API
description: Single-number stats for iOS Shortcuts and widgets.

title: Flashcard System
description: Added spaced repetition flashcards with 3D card UI, multi-deck support, and API endpoints for learning.

title: Threads Visualization
description: D3 force-directed graph showing how posts, scraps, and tags connect. Scroll through 350vh of interconnected content.

title: Scraps Browser
description: New /scraps page for browsing the Supabase scraps collection with tag filtering and metadata.

title: Kalshi Predictions Integration
description: Live prediction market portfolio tracking with real-time P&L, calibration analysis, and position commentary.

title: Gear Inventory Overhaul
description: Smart units, favorites, weight-per-category stats, and data-dense Tuftian visualizations.

title: Tufte-Style Sidenotes
description: Major typography overhaul. Footnotes now appear as margin notes on desktop.

title: Dynamic Tags System
description: Tags endpoint with journalist pyramid ordering - most important and frequently used tags surface first. Plus llms.txt for AI crawlers.

title: Cryptographic Predictions
description: 10 predictions for 2025-2029, SHA-256 hashed and committed to git so they can't be quietly edited later.

title: Scrapbook View
description: Data-dense scrapbook view with tag filtering and enhanced Pinboard bookmarklet with smart tag suggestions.

title: Predictions API
description: Predictions system with cryptographic verification - the foundation for the forecasting section.

title: Stats Dashboard
description: Personal metrics aggregating GitHub, YouTube, LastFM, Chess.com, and other APIs.

title: website2 Launch
description: Complete rebuild with Nuxt 3, Docker deployment, and new markdown processing pipeline. Fresh start after 6 years.

title: Pottery Shop & RSS
description: Added pottery page with Stripe checkout, RSS feed, and public tags.json endpoint.

title: Scrap Graph View
description: Interactive graph visualization of scraps with Supabase backend integration.

title: Tailwind Redesign
description: Major overhaul: switched from Tachyons to Tailwind CSS + Nuxt UI. Added 3D canvas experiments and GitHub data integration.

title: Art Section
description: Added dedicated art pages. Updated projects with NBC News and CCRB journalism pieces.

title: Dark Mode & Photoblog
description: Implemented dark mode toggle and automated photoblog system.

title: Markdown Pipeline
description: Rebuilt content system with markdown-it parser, table of contents, and JSON resume integration.

title: Original Site Launch
description: First version with Tachyons CSS, audio player for mixes, Pinboard bookmarks, Are.na vibes section, and a shop.
